card.name: Linking words before a named place or procedure
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, in, an, as and a comma, right before a proper place name or a procedure or condition name. Seen in 'prevention of' and 'part of an' in drug labels, and 'located in' before Florida places.

modes.label: Drug-label phrases
modes.description: 'of' or 'an' linking to a treatment or disease term such as in vitro fertilization or cardiovascular disease.
modes.example: In Normal Ovulatory Women Undergoing Controlled Ovarian Stimulation as Part<< of>> an In Vitro Fertilization or

modes.label: Place-name lead-ins
modes.description: 'in', 'of' or a comma just before a street, suburb, or city name, mostly in Florida.
modes.example: The Miami Amtrak Station is located<< in>> the industrial suburb of Hialeah on
